LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Warm-Hearted Woodsman
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Warm-Hearted Woodsman (F-05-32) is a moss-grown clockwork tin giant haunted by the pounding human heart locked inside its iron chest furnace.\nWorkers with overly high Temperance only stir its hunger for a living heart; when its Qliphoth Counter reaches 0, it lies quietly in wait to crush and devour the very next employee who enters.
